blocks.text: Panorama Ridge homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Panorama Ridge, September 2026. Detached houses: 101 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 5% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 27 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 19% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 21 sold over 4 months against an average of 94.2 listed, about 18.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 7 sold. Condos and townhomes: 22 sold over 4 months against an average of 28.8 listed, about 5.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 9 sold.

faq.q: Which schools are in or near Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: École Panorama Ridge Secondary (13220 64 Ave) and Colebrook Elementary (5404 125a St) sit in the area, with McLeod Road Traditional (6325 142 St), North Ridge Elementary (13460 62 Ave) and W E Kinvig Elementary (13266 70b Ave) also serving it — names and addresses confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: What is my child's catchment school in Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: Catchments are address-based in SD36. The one result on record in this program: 13220 64 Ave feeds North Ridge Elementary and École Panorama Ridge Secondary (SD36 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01). Every other address must be run in the locator itself.

faq.q: How did Panorama Ridge sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 101 active listings, 5 solds and a 5% sales ratio, while Condos & Townhomes recorded 27 listings, 5 solds and a 19% sales ratio; Surrey-wide, the detached median was $1,215,000 and the attached median $512,944 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What governs land use in Panorama Ridge now?
faq.a: The South Newton plan was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan update and is no longer in effect, so the OCP and Zoning Bylaw 12000 govern; the plan area the City describes covers lands north of Highway 10, east of King George Boulevard and west of 152 Street.
